events.verdict: Terry (CHI) is moving alongside Wiggins' (MIA) path as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) is moving alongside Dosunmu's (CHI) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Adebayo (MIA) and Williams (CHI) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound and a jump ball is whistled.
Buzelis (CHI) makes contact with Wiggins' (MIA) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Buzelis (CHI) brings his arm down and makes contact with the ball while defending Jaquez Jr. (MIA) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Williams (CHI) directly contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Adebayo's (MIA) hand after the release.
Replay review of the foul called on Jaquez Jr. (MIA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Jaquez Jr gets to the ball and cleanly dislodges it on the long rebound.
Adebayo (MIA) is already in Dosunmu's (CHI) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Smith (MIA) initiates contact with Buzelis' (CHI) arm and the contact affects his ability to control the ball.
Buzelis (CHI) directly contests Wiggins' (MIA) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Wiggins' (MIA) hand after the release.
Adebayo (MIA) commits a take foul on Williams (CHI).
